name: com_excel
description: Direct Microsoft Excel COM Object interface. Reads cell values, writes formulas, queries active sheets, and reads ranges instantaneously in 5ms without GUI clicking.

action.description: Excel COM action: 'status' checks running state, 'read_cell' reads a cell, 'write_cell' sets value/formula, 'read_range' reads a 2D matrix.

cell.description: Cell reference (e.g. 'A1', 'C15'). Required for read_cell and write_cell.

cols.description: Number of columns to read for read_range.

rows.description: Number of rows to read for read_range.

sheet.description: Optional worksheet name. Defaults to active worksheet.

value.description: Value or formula to write (e.g. '1234', '=SUM(A1:A10)'). Required for write_cell.
